notes: This portable C++ TCK case unpublishes an adapter-configured object class through the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador API and queries the resulting publication state through the standard IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM. The provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, names, and MIM module remain adapter-supplied; the test uses no vendor implementation hooks or DDM region APIs.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void unpublishObjectClass ( ObjectClassHandle const & objectClass) = 0
